fato_historico: 867: Byzantine emperor Michael III is murdered in his chamber by his junior emperor Basil I.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a powerful shift as you transition from past burdens toward newfound freedom. Just as the tide changes, consider releasing old conflicts and stepping into your personal power. It is a good time to embrace clarity and let go of what no longer serves your spirit, making space for new, bright beginnings to bloom.
frase_do_dia: The brightest light often emerges after the deepest shadows have faded away.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of inner truth and spiritual wisdom.
conselho: Trust your intuition and choose peace over the echoes of past drama.
